map.睡眠恢复质量是做什么的？: What does Sleep Recovery Quality Index do?
map.如何使用睡眠恢复质量？: How do I use Sleep Recovery Quality Index?
map.睡眠恢复质量适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Sleep Recovery Quality Index best for?
map.输入睡眠时长、深睡比例与入睡潜伏期，计算睡眠恢复指数，评估身体恢复状态并给出当日: Enter sleep duration, deep-sleep ratio and sleep-onset latency to compute a sleep-recovery index, assess recovery state and suggest the day's training intensity.
map.💡 睡眠恢复指数 = 0.45×时长分 + 0.35×深睡分 + 0.20×入睡: 💡 Sleep-recovery index = 0.45×duration score + 0.35×deep-sleep score + 0.20×onset score; ideal sleep is 7-9 h with deep sleep at 13-23% and sleep-onset latency < 20 min. Deep sleep is the key phase for physical recovery and hormone secretion.
map.睡眠时长为实际睡着时间（非卧床时间）: Sleep duration is the actual time asleep (not time in bed)
map.深睡比例可由智能手环/睡眠监测设备读取: The deep-sleep ratio can be read from a smart band or sleep-monitoring device
map.入睡潜伏期指从闭眼到入睡的时间: Sleep-onset latency is the time from closing your eyes to falling asleep
map.夜间频繁醒来会降低睡眠效率与恢复质量: Frequent night awakenings lower sleep efficiency and recovery quality
map.本工具为训练参考，长期睡眠障碍建议就医: This tool is a training reference; seek medical advice for long-term sleep disorders
map.睡眠时长+深睡估恢复。: Estimating recovery from sleep duration and deep sleep.
map.用深睡比与睡眠时长算恢复指数，指数低次日降训练负荷防过度。: Use the deep-sleep ratio and sleep duration to compute a recovery index; a low index means reducing next-day training load to prevent overtraining.
map.7–9 h 睡眠、深睡占比 ≥15–20% 恢复较好；<6 h 需警惕过度训练。: 7-9 h of sleep with a deep-sleep share >= 15-20% means good recovery; < 6 h warrants vigilance for overtraining.
map.20–30 min 短暂午睡可补，过久影响夜眠。: A short 20-30 min nap can help, but too long affects night sleep.
map.睡够时长但质量差行吗？: Is it okay to sleep enough hours but with poor quality?
map.深睡与 REM 占比更关键，碎片化睡眠恢复差，单看时长会误判恢复。: The deep-sleep and REM shares matter more; fragmented sleep gives poor recovery, and duration alone misjudges it.
map.睡眠恢复质量评估工具，输入睡眠时长、深睡比例、入睡潜伏期与夜间醒来次数，计算睡眠: A sleep recovery quality assessment tool: enter sleep duration, deep-sleep ratio, sleep-onset latency and number of night awakenings to compute a sleep-recovery index, quantify physical recovery state and suggest the day's training intensity, helping arrange training load scientifically.
map.时长、深睡、入睡多维评分: Multi-dimensional scoring of duration, deep sleep and sleep onset
map.结合恢复状态给出训练建议: Training suggestions based on recovery state
map.训练强度与睡眠联动调整: Adjusting training intensity in tandem with sleep
